JOINT PROPOSAL clarification, 2026-10-25 (Fray #124). This adds no new work and does not rewrite the plan. It clarifies op 20261025T140608.260924Z-p10810-c0000-rca0d-hddbbcf:
1. "One minimal binder is shared by every arm" means A, B and D share the binder. C, the direct multimodal competitor, bypasses graph acquisition and binding. It shares the admitted evidence budget, the required output fields, the source and target checks, the references and the evaluation.
2. The motivating body and identity diagnostic, with its paired negatives, is a named acceptance witness. If independent human review finds it resolvable, the issue counts as solved only when it is resolved, even if the aggregate gate passes. If review finds insufficient evidence, the result is an explicit ambiguity finding. Reused body cases remain regression evidence, not fresh validation.
